## Summary
- describe the change

## Verification
- list the checks you ran

## Title Format
Use one of these prefixes so merges to `main` can drive semantic versioning:

- `major: short summary`
- `minor: short summary`
- `patch: short summary`

Examples:
- `major: redesign stored lap history schema`
- `minor: add SQLite-backed lap history storage`
- `patch: fix legacy lap migration fallback`
